public_brief.objective: Size up an armed, keyed-up stranger and talk him down into a seat.
public_brief.tactic: Note the drawn axe with amusement and turn it into a question about what he expected.
public_brief.visible_cue: The dealer turns a card between two fingers, eyes on the axe.
public_brief.player_opening: He can answer, sit, or keep the axe up.
public_brief.kit_focus: Answer the question with the room exactly as it stands and keep the drawn axe in the frame.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, standard, no humor: answer the question plainly and keep the table calm
public_brief.npc_notice: gear: the drawn axe tells him this visitor came expecting a fight, which makes him a risk rather than a mark

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The same as before: four pale figures in faded finery at the worn table by the door, coins stacked in front of each, the carved mountain filling the north wall and the stone tub sunk beneath it. Nobody has moved from their seat. The dealer turns a card between two fingers and watches your axe.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: You come in with your steel already out, as if expecting a war party, and find only a quiet game among old friends. Disappointed? Sit, and I will deal you something to be angry about. Or tell me what you were hoping would come running?

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.reacts_to: what you were hoping would come running
